This plot is very small, and I cannot risk cash on fertilizer from the cooperative for such a small piece. I will use manure and compost from home, keep the local plants I already know, and work it with my family the way I did before. I will not hire labor, and I will not buy chemicals unless I see a bad problem, so this season I will go without them.
